describe.description: The image shows a single large, robust felid standing in profile on a plain off-white background with a soft gray shadow beneath its feet, facing to the right with its head turned three-quarters toward the viewer. It has a muscular, deep-chested body covered in short dense tawny golden-brown fur that is paler cream-white on the chin, chest, belly and inner legs, with faint to moderate dark brown striping and spotting across the body. The head is broad with a short muzzle, the neck and chest bear longer shaggy fur forming a ruff, and the limbs are thick and sturdy ending in large rounded paws. A short thin tail with dark banding and a dark tip extends from the rear. The overall stance is calm and alert, with all four feet on the ground.

describe.description: A large, heavy-bodied feline stands in side view facing right with its head turned toward the viewer. It has a tawny golden-brown coat with pale cream-white fur on the muzzle, chin, chest and lower legs and faint dark striping over the forehead, body and more distinctly on the hind legs. Its build is massive with a deep chest, thick forelegs, large paws, slightly sloping back, and a short banded tail with a dark tuft visible behind the left hind leg. The face is broad with small rounded ears, forward-facing eyes, a broad nose, and long pale whiskers.
